cover_concept.prompt:
Use case: compositing, identity-preserve. Create ONE review-only game title-screen cover concept for the Traditional Chinese math adventure game 數學勇者. This is an art approval mockup, not production sprites or an implemented screen. Landscape 16:9 canvas, target 1920 x 1080, fully opaque painted background. Single image, one frame, no atlas or grid. Keep every required character, entire sword, hands, boots, cape, shadows, and existing effects fully inside the canvas with at least 64 pixels padding at the target size. Do not crop or distort the figures.

Input image 1 is the locked original full-body illustration of the heroine 黎薇 (Livy), a warm-brown-skinned young female hero with shoulder-length braided brown hair, one gold hair ornament, navy clothing, teal-blue waist-length cape, compass, brown long boots, and exactly ONE blue glowing sword. Input image 2 is the locked original full-body illustration of the ancient demon king 赫恩 (Hearn), the 奪輝王, with dark wavy hair, distinctive white hair streak, goatee, dark charcoal clothes, purple-lined sweeping cloak, gold clasp and brown boots. Preserve both original characters' identity, face, costume, accessories, proportions, and painted rendering extremely closely. Compose the supplied figures into the scene; do not redesign them, do not make them photorealistic or pixel art, and do not mirror costume asymmetries. Livy appears on the left third, Hearn on the right third. Her stance is courageous and composed, his expression intelligent and threatening. Use their supplied full-body poses and silhouettes. Hearn never has a sword or plant decoration. Preserve only the small existing magic effect from his reference; it is an illustration motif and not a new defined power. Do not change Livy's cover pose into the later pixel-art stance.

Background: a modestly detailed ancient stone courtyard under a dramatic dusk sky, with irregular weathered stone texture, a few large offset architectural silhouettes and hazy distant hills, foreground and background separation, grounded contact shadows. This is a proposed ancient cover location, not a canon claim about current world geography. No destroyed or breaking seals, no portals, no plot about a returned demon king, no other characters. The current Twilight Forest is peaceful because Livy defeated and sealed Hearn long ago; this title screen presents that past legend. Use subdued indigo and muted plum atmosphere on Hearn's side, restrained blue-teal accent near Livy's actual sword, and warm natural grazing light on stone. Atmospheric drama comes from scale, value contrast and depth, not dense glitter or arbitrary luminous rings. Visually asymmetric composition and believable cloth, worn leather and brush texture. Avoid sterile gloss, mirror symmetry, repetitive meaningless gold ornament, excessive particles and overly smooth surfaces.

Composition: put the two entire characters on a shared ground plane near the left and right edges, leaving a generous open central third for game typography. Keep sky and scenery behind the central text low contrast and quiet. A visual hierarchy of large title in the upper center, one integrated game-like start control beneath it, and three short legible instruction lines lower in the central space. These are elements within a full-screen game scene, not a website. No webpage header, navigation, cards, sidebar, dashboard, boxed tutorial panels, or browser chrome. Do not show HUD, health bars, answer choices, world lore sections, rewards or pixel sprites in this concept. Scene extends edge to edge. The start control can look like a simple worn stone inset with a restrained blue rim, no ornate gold frame. Keep all wording clear and readable, do not shrink to cram.

Render only the following exact Traditional Chinese text:
Large main title: 「數學勇者」
One start control: 「開始冒險」
Below the control, three concise instruction lines:
「答對：出劍，壓回敵人蓄力」
「答錯：敵人反擊」
「敵人蓄力滿：受到攻擊」
Do not render quotation marks, character labels, extra text, decorative unreadable script, subtitles, artist signature, watermark or English. Typography should suit a painted fantasy game, with solid legibility and minimal ornament. This is a cover mockup only; actual gameplay remains pixel art and will be designed later.
